name: Scale-invariant SDR loss
description: Negative SI-SDR in decibels for waveform tensors [batch,...], after per-example mean removal; minimization convention.

parameters.eps: positive energy floor for silent/near-silent examples
parameters.reduction: none per waveform, mean, or sum

examples.title: Train DDSP synthesis with SI-SDR
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 pitch=torch.full((4,),220.0+int(ctx.index)%20)
 loudness=torch.full((4,),0.4)
 time=torch.arange(128,dtype=torch.float32)/8000
 audio=loudness[0]*torch.sin(2*torch.pi*pitch[0]*time)
 return {"audio":synth.Audio(audio,sr=8000),"pitch":pitch,"loudness":loudness,"sample_rate":8000,"lengths":128}
ds=synth.Spec("sisdr-audio",generator=samples,size=16,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("audio-reconstruct",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("audio-reconstruct",split="val",like=train)
model=build("ddsp-synthesizer","tiny",sample_rate=8000,n_harmonics=3,control_rate=100,fir_size=3)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="audio-reconstruct",recipe_config={"loss":"si-sdr","mode":"ddsp-controls","sample_rate":8000},max_epochs=1,batch_size=4,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
